dialogues.jp:
俺は、ベンチに腰掛けて叶が来るのを待ってい
た。
dialogues.en: So warm, yet so overflowing and deep...
dialogues.text: So warm, yet so overflowing and deep...

dialogues.jp:
公園の主のように立っていたあの桜が散った今、
記憶と違うその風景はあるべき姿のはずなのに
どうしても違和感を拭えない。
dialogues.en: "Kanae... I love you."
dialogues.text: "Kanae... I love you."

dialogues.jp: カサ……。
dialogues.en: I slowly pulled out, then pushed back in strongly.
dialogues.text: I slowly pulled out, then pushed back in strongly.

dialogues.en:
Her body arched forward, her voice growing louder and
louder.
dialogues.text:
Her body arched forward, her voice growing louder and
louder.

dialogues.jp: 落ちた青葉を踏む、かすかな足音に顔をあげる。
dialogues.en:
The pained look on her face was a far cry from the sweet
voice emnating from her mouth.
dialogues.text:
The pained look on her face was a far cry from the sweet
voice emnating from her mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun... I love... love you... uhnn, unngh... ahhh,
ahhhh..."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun... I love... love you... uhnn, unngh... ahhh,
ahhhh..."

dialogues.jp:
そこに和装に身を包んだ叶が立っていた。心な
しか血の気のない頬は夜桜のようにほの白い。
dialogues.en:
She's really going to leave me. Going to disappear in front
of me...
dialogues.text:
She's really going to leave me. Going to disappear in front
of me...

dialogues.jp:
「調子悪そうなのに、呼び出したりしてごめん。
　でも、どうしても顔を見て話がしたかったん
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"Kanae.... Kanae, I love you... so much... I'd always be
beside you... I want to be beside you..."
dialogues.text:
"Kanae.... Kanae, I love you... so much... I'd always be
beside you... I want to be beside you..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、身体は何ともないから」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... Asakura-kun... uhnn!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... Asakura-kun... uhnn!"

dialogues.jp: 叶はそう言って微笑んだ。
dialogues.en:
Her body and mine were glued to each other. The feeling of
her warmth, I etched it into my memory.
dialogues.text:
Her body and mine were glued to each other. The feeling of
her warmth, I etched it into my memory.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「大事な話って………………何ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Uhn, uhnn, uhnnnn, aahh, ungh..."
dialogues.text: "Uhn, uhnn, uhnnnn, aahh, ungh..."

dialogues.jp: ためらうように叶が口を開く。
dialogues.en: All over, her body was radiating heat.
dialogues.text: All over, her body was radiating heat.

dialogues.en: I wanted to remember it, her entire body.
dialogues.text: I wanted to remember it, her entire body.

dialogues.jp:
そういってからひとつ深呼吸。気持ちを落ち着
かせた。
dialogues.en:
Even if I wanted to, I wouldn't be able to. That feeling,
that warmth, that voice...
dialogues.text:
Even if I wanted to, I wouldn't be able to. That feeling,
that warmth, that voice...

dialogues.jp:
「……俺は、君が好きだ。ずっと側にいたいと
　思ってる」
dialogues.en:
Her hair was a mess. The sweat on her forehead was making
her brow stick to it.
dialogues.text:
Her hair was a mess. The sweat on her forehead was making
her brow stick to it.

dialogues.jp:
叶はどことなく不安な表情になった。しかし、
口を開くことなく次の言葉を待つ。
dialogues.en: Her entire body was heating up, and ozzing sweat.
dialogues.text: Her entire body was heating up, and ozzing sweat.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、それ以上に君のことが心配なんだ。こ
　れ以上学園に残る努力を続けたら、君の身体
　に大きな負担をかけてしまう」
dialogues.en:
I kissed her stomach, and started to lick up all the sweat
with my tongue.
dialogues.text:
I kissed her stomach, and started to lick up all the sweat
with my tongue.

dialogues.jp: 俺の言葉を聞き、叶は大きく息を呑んだ。
dialogues.en: A salty taste, just like tears.
dialogues.text: A salty taste, just like tears.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そんな……！　私だって、朝倉君と一緒にい
　たいよ！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.jp: 声をあげようとする叶をかるく手で制する。
dialogues.en: "Uhn, kuuh... haah, haah"
dialogues.text: "Uhn, kuuh... haah, haah"

dialogues.jp:
「暦先生が言っていたんだ。本当の姿に戻って
　も、学園を移らずにすむ方法があるって。本
　当？」
dialogues.en:
--I'm swelling up as well. Her feelings were filling up my
heart, and heating up my member...
dialogues.text:
--I'm swelling up as well. Her feelings were filling up my
heart, and heating up my member...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Ah, mm... ungh"
dialogues.text: "Ah, mm... ungh"

dialogues.jp: 何故だか叶は急に頬を染めた。
dialogues.en: "Kuuuu! Kanae--!"
dialogues.text: "Kuuuu! Kanae--!"

dialogues.jp:
そのほのかな薄紅に、俺は枯れてしまった桜が
もう一度花をつけたような錯覚に襲われる。
dialogues.en: "Yes.... yes... I'm coming, inside Kanae..."
dialogues.text: "Yes.... yes... I'm coming, inside Kanae..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「…………ええ、本当です」
おずおずと頷く。
dialogues.en: She grabbed my arm tightly.
dialogues.text: She grabbed my arm tightly.

dialogues.jp:
「俺はどうすればいい？　何か俺が出来ること
　はないのか？」
dialogues.en: ──Spurrrt, splursh... spurt.
dialogues.text: ──Spurrrt, splursh... spurt.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Mm, mmm, mmmmwaahhh~~~!"
dialogues.text: "Mm, mmm, mmmmwaahhh~~~!"

dialogues.jp: 叶は｛とまど／躊躇｝うように口をつぐんだ。
dialogues.en: "Ugh, uhnn..."
dialogues.text: "Ugh, uhnn..."

dialogues.en:
I was surprised myself at how much I ejaculated. It was
overflowing out of her small place.
dialogues.text:
I was surprised myself at how much I ejaculated. It was
overflowing out of her small place.

dialogues.jp: もう一度、強く叶の名を呼ぶ。
dialogues.en: It leaked down her bush, dirtying her even further.
dialogues.text: It leaked down her bush, dirtying her even further.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "--Haah, haah, haah. ...You came a lot."
dialogues.text: "--Haah, haah, haah. ...You came a lot."

dialogues.jp:
ふっと息を吐き、ゆっくりと俺の瞳を見つめる
叶。
dialogues.en:
Is this really the last time I'd see that smile...? The only
way to save her is for her to leave? That can't be...
dialogues.text:
Is this really the last time I'd see that smile...? The only
way to save her is for her to leave? That can't be...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君……私を好きだって言ってくれました
　よね。その気持ちに嘘はありませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun... I love you. I love you so much."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun... I love you. I love you so much."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前だろ」
dialogues.en: "--Hey, let's kiss again."
dialogues.text: "--Hey, let's kiss again."

dialogues.jp: 俺はしっかりと頷いて答えた。
dialogues.en: She slowly turned to face me.
dialogues.text: She slowly turned to face me.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「生涯を……私と一緒に歩んで行ってくれます　
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-kun... you said that you really loved me. Those
feelings aren't lies, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-kun... you said that you really loved me. Those
feelings aren't lies, right?"

dialogues.jp:
真剣な瞳で、ひとことひとこと紡ぎだす――そ
れは、まるでプロポーズのような言葉だった。
dialogues.en:
I firmly said my piece, with a nod. A statement I could say
over and over again if needed.
dialogues.text:
I firmly said my piece, with a nod. A statement I could say
over and over again if needed.

dialogues.jp: 俺は迷うことなく素直な気持ちを口に出した。
dialogues.en:
Her eyes showed her seriousness, as she said each word
clearly and precisely. Unfazed and certain, I answered with
my honest feelings.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes showed her seriousness, as she said each word
clearly and precisely. Unfazed and certain, I answered with
my honest feelings.

dialogues.en:
"...Yes, they won't change. I want to be by your side, and
protect you, forever."
dialogues.text:
"...Yes, they won't change. I want to be by your side, and
protect you, forever."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「有難う御座います」
dialogues.en: "--Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "--Thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
叶は丁寧にお辞儀をして……どこか決意を秘め
た表情で顔をあげた。
dialogues.en:
Kanae gave me a polite bow... then lifted her head, her face
looking very determined.
dialogues.text:
Kanae gave me a polite bow... then lifted her head, her face
looking very determined.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「その言葉が聞ければ、私は頑張れます」
dialogues.en: "With those words, I am now prepared as well."
dialogues.text: "With those words, I am now prepared as well."

dialogues.jp:
強い意志と｛はかな／儚｝さを同時に含んだ不思議な瞳で俺
に微笑みかける。
dialogues.en:
Eyes with such strong will, yet seeming so empty at the same
time... those strange eyes looked at me as she smiled.
dialogues.text:
Eyes with such strong will, yet seeming so empty at the same
time... those strange eyes looked at me as she smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「さようなら……朝倉君」
dialogues.en: "Farewell... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Farewell... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
ただ立ち尽くす俺の前を、和装姿の美少女はゆっ
くり去っていった。
dialogues.en: Her final words came back to haunt me.
dialogues.text: Her final words came back to haunt me.

dialogues.en: "Farewell... Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Farewell... Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp: 『さようなら』
dialogues.en:
Her words... what did they mean? Somehow, I don't think our
fate is meant to end here...
dialogues.text:
Her words... what did they mean? Somehow, I don't think our
fate is meant to end here...

dialogues.jp:
彼女の言葉は……いったい、どういう意味だっ
たのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Completely clueless about the future, the wind blowing past
my shoulder died out, and the dancing leaves fell to the
ground.
dialogues.text:
Completely clueless about the future, the wind blowing past
my shoulder died out, and the dancing leaves fell to the
ground.

dialogues.jp:
正体の分からない不安にかられる俺の肩に、風
にちぎれた桜の葉が一枚舞い落ちた。
dialogues.en: ◆Only One Way◆
dialogues.text: ◆Only One Way◆

dialogues.jp: ◆ただ一つの方法◆
dialogues.en:
I called Kanae to meet her at the Sakura Park, in order to
find out what that one way that Koyomi-sensei talked about
was...
dialogues.text:
I called Kanae to meet her at the Sakura Park, in order to
find out what that one way that Koyomi-sensei talked about
was...

dialogues.jp:
俺は叶を桜公園に呼び出した。暦先生が言って
いた方法を聞くために……。
dialogues.en:
When she arrived, she invited me to the school, and asked me
to hold her one last time.
dialogues.text:
When she arrived, she invited me to the school, and asked me
to hold her one last time.

dialogues.jp:
約束の場所にあらわれた叶は、俺の気持ちを尋
ねるのだった。
dialogues.en: After that, she asked about my true feelings.
dialogues.text: After that, she asked about my true feelings.

dialogues.jp:
俺の叶を好きだという気持ちに嘘はない。生涯
をともに歩んで行きたいと思う心にも……。
dialogues.en:
My feelings for her aren't a lie. Deep in my heart, I know I
want to spend the rest of my life with her...
dialogues.text:
My feelings for her aren't a lie. Deep in my heart, I know I
want to spend the rest of my life with her...

dialogues.jp:
そんな返事を聞くと、叶は何かを決意したよう
だった。
dialogues.en: Upon hearing my reply, she seemed to become determined.
dialogues.text: Upon hearing my reply, she seemed to become determined.

dialogues.jp:
立ち去った叶の後に、一人残された俺は、何か
正体のわからない不安に包まれるような感覚に
襲われたのだった。
dialogues.en:
She then left, leaving me behind, completely clueless and
uncertain of the future.
dialogues.text:
She then left, leaving me behind, completely clueless and
uncertain of the future.
